title: CISG Article 11 — writing not generally required
shortTitle: CISG Article 11 — writing not generally required
summary: The comparative note quotes Article 11’s rule that a sale contract need not be in or evidenced by writing.
notes: The reproduced text permits proof by any means, including witnesses, and says no other requirement as to form is imposed by Article 11. Its operation must be understood within the Convention’s scope and qualifications; the assigned pages do not supply a complete CISG applicability outline.
